description: List sequences related to an OEIS entry. direction outgoing returns the A-numbers named in the entry's cross-reference (Cf.) lines, with any parenthetical note beside each; direction incoming returns entries that mention this A-number anywhere. Each row carries the related sequence's name and first terms. 10 rows per page.

aNumber.description: OEIS A-number, e.g. "A000045"; oeis_identify_sequence and oeis_search_sequences return them. Also accepts "a000045", "A45", "45", and an oeis.org sequence URL; all normalize to the zero-padded form. Legacy M/N book numbers (e.g. "M1459") are not A-numbers: find them with oeis_search_sequences.

direction.description: outgoing (default): the A-numbers this entry cross-references. incoming: the entries that mention this A-number.

start.description: Row offset: 0, 10, … 100 (at most 110 rows are reachable per entry and direction). Pass nextStart from the previous page.

name: oeis_get_cross_refs

aNumber.description: The entry whose relations are listed, e.g. "A000045".

effectiveQuery.description: The query as OEIS parsed it (lowercased upstream), e.g. seq:1,2,5,14,42.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `sequence_not_found`: No OEIS entry exists for the requested A-number. Raised for direction outgoing only; direction incoming reports that no entry mentions it. `pacer_shed`: The oeis.org request queue would exceed its wait budget on the record fetch or the incoming search. `upstream_rate_limited`: oeis.org answered HTTP 429 Too Many Requests on the record fetch or the incoming search, and retries within the call did not clear it. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

lines.description: Outgoing only: the entry's cross-reference lines verbatim, written by OEIS contributors; lineIndex points into this list.

nextStart.description: Pass as start for the next page; absent on the last reachable page.

notice.description: Guidance: why nothing matched, how to narrow the query, or how to reach the next page.

related.description: Related sequences on this page: outgoing in order of first mention, incoming in OEIS relevance order.

aNumber.description: Related A-number; pass it to oeis_get_sequence for the full entry.

author.description: Author line as OEIS records it, written by OEIS contributors; absent when not resolved, and when the entry has none, as on a reserved or recycled A-number.

firstIndex.description: The index n of the first term; absent with offset.

keywords.description: Keyword flags such as nonn, core, tabl (oeis_list_reference topic keywords decodes them); absent when not resolved.

legacyIds.description: Legacy book numbers, e.g. ["M0692", "N0256"]; absent when not resolved, on entries that have none, and when OEIS sends no readable edit line.

lineIndex.description: Outgoing only: 0-based index into lines of the first cross-reference line naming this A-number.

modified.description: When the entry was last edited, ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. "2026-09-23T16:08:09-04:00"; absent when not resolved, and when OEIS sends no readable edit time.

name.description: Sequence name, written by OEIS contributors; absent when not resolved.

note.description: Outgoing only: the parenthetical written beside the A-number in a cross-reference line, e.g. "phi"; written by OEIS contributors.

offset.description: Offset "i,p": i is the index n of the first term, p the 1-based position of the first term with |a(n)| > 1. Absent when not resolved, and on a reserved or recycled A-number (keyword allocated or recycled).

resolved.description: True when name and terms were fetched. False when OEIS returned no record for this A-number or the lookup could not be made (see notice); name, terms, offset, firstIndex, keywords, author, legacyIds, and modified are then absent.

terms.description: Data-line terms as exact decimal strings, signs kept; absent when not resolved.

url.description: Sequence page on oeis.org; cite it wherever the entry is reused.

start.description: The row offset of this page. For incoming, as OEIS served it: below the requested start when that start was past the last entry (OEIS then serves the last page).

totalCount.description: Total rows: the match count OEIS reported, or for outgoing cross-references the number of distinct A-numbers the entry names.

truncated.description: True when more rows exist than this page shows.

title: Get OEIS Cross-References
